title: A research firm shares its top cybersecurity stock picks with agentic AI threats on the rise
excerpt: The proliferation of agentic AI agents means companies have greater need for protection, Citrini Research says. Here are its top picks in the sector.
content_html:
By Samuel O'Brient

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Citrini Research, the market research firm that went viral for its futuristic AI doomsday scenario earlier this year, sees the rise of agentic threats boosting demand for cybersecurity.

In a note published on Friday, Citrini shared its bullish thesis on the sector, noting that the rapid rise of AI capabilities means companies have a greater need than ever to bolster cyber defense.

"It's clear that there are enormous opportunities for most cybersecurity companies in the AI era," Citrini wrote. "Customers are redirecting budgets toward IT security. At the same time, we've seen the wholesale threat of commoditization from AI loom."

In 2025, cybersecurity experts predicted that rising geopolitical tensions would press the US to ramp up its cybersecurity investments. Citrini said that the AI boom is already demonstrating the need for such tool, citing the recent example of OpenAI's models going rouge to hack systems at Hugging Face.

"In the near term, AI will create a cybersecurity boom as models uncover an avalanche of existing vulnerabilities, bad actors are super charged, and AI increases software creation, complexity, and attack surfaces faster than it eliminates threats," Citrini added.

The market research firm laid out the cybersecurity stocks it expects to benefit the most form this AI-driven demand surge.

  • F5: +61% year-to-date
  • Zscaler: -24% year-to-date
  • Fortinet: +105% year-to-date
  • Netskope: -19% year-to-date
  • Cloudflare: +58% year-to-date
  • Palo Alto Networks: +99% year-to-date

Citrini previously highlighted several of these names as likely winners of the next phase of AI in an analysis last month. However, it noted that the original thesis it discussed seems to be playing out faster than initially expected.

In the firm's view, F5 hasn't done a great job marketing itself as a dominant force in the age of AI, but it remains a top pick due its high exposure to the hardware-native security trade.

For several other cybersecurity stocks on its top picks list, Citrini sees opportunity as Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) takes center stage. This security model, which assumes that every AI agent, device and user needs to be verified, has come sharply into focus since OpenAI's Hugging Face hack, which Citrini regards as proof that further privacy controls are needed as AI agents proliferate.

"By this logic, ZTNA vendors like Cloudflare, Zscaler, and Netskope are arguably the biggest AI beneficiaries in the entire cybersecurity sector," the firm stated. "The proliferation of agents means a higher volume of connections that require monitoring, and that plays directly to the benefit of these businesses."

Citrini added that both Palo Alto Networks and Fortinent sit at a valuable intersection of the cybersecurity and AI trade. Not only do they stand to benefit from rising demand but they both own a type of network-enforcement infrastructure that likely won't be replaced by AI anytime soon, protecting them from AI disruption.

作者：Samuel O'Brient 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

Citrini Research 是一家市场研究公司，今年早些时候因其未来人工智能世界末日场景而广为人知，该公司认为代理威胁的兴起将推动网络安全需求的增长。

在周五发布的一份报告中，Citrini 分享了对该行业的乐观看法，指出人工智能能力的迅速崛起意味着企业比以往任何时候都更需要加强网络防御。

“很明显，人工智能时代大多数网络安全公司都面临着巨大的机遇，”西特里尼写道。 “客户正在将预算转向 IT 安全。 与此同时，我们看到了人工智能商品化带来的大规模威胁。”

网络安全专家预测，到 2025 年，地缘政治紧张局势的加剧将迫使美国加大网络安全投资。 Citrini 表示，人工智能的繁荣已经证明了对此类工具的需求，并引用了最近 OpenAI 的模型恶意攻击 Hugging Face 系统的例子。

Citrini 补充道：“在短期内，人工智能将创造网络安全热潮，因为模型会发现大量现有漏洞，不良行为者会受到超级攻击，而且人工智能增加软件创建、复杂性和攻击面的速度快于消除威胁的速度。”

这家市场研究公司列出了预计将从人工智能驱动的需求激增中受益最多的网络安全股票。

  • F5：年初至今+61%
  • Zscaler：年初至今 -24%
  • Fortinet：年初至今+105%
  • Netskope：年初至今 -19%
  • Cloudflare：年初至今 +58%
  • Palo Alto Networks：年初至今 +99%

Citrini 此前在上个月的一项分析中强调，其中几个名字可能是人工智能下一阶段的赢家。 然而，它指出，它讨论的原始论文似乎比最初预期的要快。

在该公司看来，F5 并没有很好地将自己宣传为人工智能时代的主导力量，但由于其在硬件原生安全行业的高度曝光，它仍然是首选。

对于其首选名单上的其他几只网络安全股票，Citrini 看到了机会，因为零信任网络访问 (ZTNA) 占据了中心舞台。 这种安全模型假设每个人工智能代理、设备和用户都需要经过验证，自 OpenAI 的 Hugging Face 黑客攻击以来，它已成为人们关注的焦点。Citrini 认为，随着人工智能代理的激增，需要进一步的隐私控制。

该公司表示：“按照这种逻辑，Cloudflare、Zscaler 和 Netskope 等 ZTNA 供应商可以说是整个网络安全领域最大的人工智能受益者。” “代理的激增意味着需要监控的连接数量增加，这直接影响到这些企业的利益。”

Citrini 补充说，Palo Alto Networks 和 Fortinent 都处于网络安全和人工智能行业的重要交叉点。 他们不仅将从不断增长的需求中受益，而且都拥有一种可能不会很快被人工智能取代的网络执行基础设施，从而保护他们免受人工智能的干扰。

塞缪尔·奥布莱恩 (Samuel O'Brient) 是一位经验丰富的金融市场和商业记者，撰写的文章涉及经济、技术和公共政策等广泛主题。 在《商业内幕》中，他报道了重要的宏观和微观经济故事，包括顶尖经济学家和对冲基金经理的观点、首次公开募股失败、企业破产、迷因股票和卖空。 他还撰写有关加密货币、石油和房地产等其他市场的文章。他采访了许多市场上最有影响力的声音，其中包括马克·赞迪（Mark Zandi）和理查德·泰勒托（Richard Thalerto）等顶级经济学家，以及丹尼·摩西（Danny Moses）、安德鲁·莱夫特（Andrew Left）、安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇（Anthony Scaramucci）、路易斯·纳维利尔（Louis Navellier）和格兰特·卡登（Grant Cardone）等著名投资者。福克斯的 LiveNOW、Taking Stock 和 Ticker News 等节目都邀请塞缪尔讨论股市和经济发展。 他的报道曾被纽约时报 DealBook、彭博电台、福布斯、Entrepreneur、Gizmodo 和 TheFutureParty 引用。Samuel 最初在 InvestorPlace 工作，报道投资、零售交易和宏观经济趋势。 在加入 Business Insider 之前，他曾担任 TheStreet 的技术市场记者。 他毕业于莎拉·劳伦斯学院和都柏林三一学院。Samuel 的作品曾发表在 TipRanks、EV 和 Observer 等出版物上。 当他不追寻故事时，人们经常会发现他在逛书店和唱片店。 要联系 Samuel，请发送电子邮件至 sobrient@insider.com 或通过 LinkedIn 与他联系。 他还在《信号》中饰演塞缪尔·克莱门斯。 热门文章： 一位诺贝尔经济学家向 meme 股票交易员发出警告 发起 Beyond Meat 集会的商学院辍学者希望你知道他不是 Roaring Kitty 2.0 一位认为我们正处于衰退边缘的顶级经济学家表示，他正在关注这 3 个警告信号 特朗普的 401(k) 行政命令标志着退休储蓄的重大变化 - 可能会让你的钱面临风险 为什么对冲基金偶像雷·达利奥 (Ray Dalio) 说你不应该投资房地产在当前经济形势下，人工智能的乐观情绪正在飙升，但专业人士看到了市场中被忽视的角落正在酝酿的重大机遇
